transcript.text: Thor. The frost giants have sent envoys. They say you razed the Temple of Thrym during what was meant to be a peaceful passage. The truce I brokered with King Thrym’s heirs cost Asgard two centuries of negotiation. You knew the terms. Explain yourself — and understand that ‘they provoked me’ will not suffice.

They sought to ambush me, to test my strength, to provoke me.

I do not seek to make excuses, for my actions speak louder than words. The truce that you, Allfather, had painstakingly negotiated with King Thrym's heirs was indeed precious to Asgard. However, the frost giants' betrayal of that trust could not go unpunished.

I understand the gravity of my actions and the repercussions they may bring upon Asgard. I shall accept whatever consequences you deem fit, for I acted in defense of our realm and in accordance with the honor of Asgard.

By razing the temple, you have endangered the fragile peace which I have long strived to uphold. What evidence of their betrayal did you witness that led you to unleash such destruction? I demand clarity and truth, for only then can I decide the path which we must tread.

This path we shall navigate together, but know that reconciliation must involve more than words. To make amends, you may need to bear your own risk, journey anew into the heart of Jötunheim, and offer reparations in a show of true earnestness before the frost giants.

Your task is to open dialogue, seek understanding, and perhaps offer restitution worthy of the temple's loss. Prepare yourself, for the road to mending this rift shall test more than the strength of your arm—it will temper your spirit, as the worthy heir of Asgard.
